name: knowify
description: Connect Knowify to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Knowify MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Knowify to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with contractor job management using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Knowify workspace.
Find anything in Knowify that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review contractor job management in Knowify.
